_doc: Firing smoke of tank guns, the PaK 40 and the Flak 18 (Fx::muzzle) and the launcher backblast (Fx::backblast). Read once at start-up by fx.cpp (docs/settings.md#firing-smoke). Sizes scale with the gun's muzzleScale (vehicle JSON gun.muzzleScale, station muzzleScale). Alpha fades as (life left)^fadePow after a quick fade-in. Before 2026-11 the discharge left 20 puffs at alpha 0.5-0.55 living 3-5 s.

smallArms._doc: WS1 (the user: intensify muzzle smoke for WW2 guns): each shot of a WW2 small arm (weapon json smoke, default 1; modern and blaster guns 0) leaves puffs x smoke at the muzzle, drifting forward and slowing (drag), growing, fading as (life left)^fadePow. Sized against the user's Garand reference (docs/garand_ads_fire_reference.md, tools/gr1/smoke_measure.py: about 0.35 peak opacity, lingering through the 0.6 s to the next shot). Each gun has a budget of perGunBurst puffs topped up at perGunPuffsPerSecond, so automatic fire keeps a thin stream, not a wall. Perf switch ww2smoke.
